item.title: The Monday Brief — August 3, 2026
item.description: Good morning, and welcome to the Monday Brief. Here's what actually earned a spot on this week's list — no filler, just the stuff worth carving out real time for. Nine picks this week, across podcasts, video, music, film, television, and books, and we'll move through them roughly in that order. Let's start with audio. If you only have room…
